rotatingTitles: Reveal the beauty of your smile
hero.subtitle: The practice places great emphasis on continuing education to provide precise, aesthetic and long-lasting care. Additional training in root canal treatments, aesthetic composites and dental veneers. An approach favouring conservative treatments and the utmost preservation of natural tooth tissue. Every treatment is personalised, with attentive listening to each patient's expectations. The goal: natural, harmonious and long-lasting results, using solutions tailored to every situation.

about.title: Dr Myriam Lahlou Dental Clinic
about.subtitle: Aesthetics in the service of well-being

practitioner.name: Dr Myriam Lahlou
practitioner.paragraph1: At the Dr Lahlou Clinic in Casablanca, the goal is clear: to enhance the smile to transform everyday life. Specialised in aesthetic dentistry and especially veneers, the clinic offers quality care that combines precision, natural results and durability.
practitioner.paragraph2: Every patient is welcomed with warmth in a cosy, calming space designed to put them at ease from the very first moments. Dr Lahlou takes the time to listen, understand expectations, and offer tailor-made solutions to reveal the beauty of every smile.

about.paragraph1: Every treatment is carried out with patience and meticulous care. All the time needed is devoted to every detail to achieve restorations that are aesthetic, functional and comfortable alike.
about.paragraph2: Because a beautiful smile does not always require complex treatments, simple gestures, when carried out with precision and attention to detail, can sometimes naturally enhance a smile.
about.paragraph3: Listening and communication play an essential role in patient care: taking the time to understand each patient's expectations helps build a treatment that truly matches them.

testimonials.title: What Our Patients Say
testimonials.subtitle: Real experiences from patients who trusted us with their smile.

items.name: Salma A.
items.text: I was terrified of dentists, but Dr Lahlou was incredibly patient and gentle. My whitening session was quick and painless. I finally love my smile!

items.name: Youssef B.
items.text: Implant surgery sounded scary, but Dr Lahlou explained every step and I felt zero pain. The result looks completely natural. Highly recommended.

items.name: Aïcha M.
items.text: Incredibly thin veneers with a very natural finish. Booking via WhatsApp was super easy too. Many thanks!

items.name: Khalid D.
items.text: Loved my aesthetic crown: very professional follow-up and fair pricing. The modern equipment makes all the difference.
